BiblicalUsage: yôwm means a day. In Ezra 4:15 we read, "That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records..." It appears again in Ezra 4:19: "And I commanded, and search hath been made..."
TheologicalSignificance: yowm is a day, and what I take from it is that God speaks plainly, so I should listen plainly too.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
